verdict_reason: Thorough real-mode coverage of the type guard, roles question, UK-only types, in-progress entry and handshake roles, with one self-contradicting test title.

todos.issue: The title 'GET opens the Country select on its blank first option, Select a country, with United Kingdom selected' contradicts itself: the assertions (lines 1607-1611) prove the blank option is listed first and United Kingdom is the selected option, so the select opens on United Kingdom, not on the blank option. The title was edited in this PR from '...with nothing selected'.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertions prove, that the Country select lists Select a country first and opens with United Kingdom selected. One way: 'GET lists Select a country first and opens the Country select on United Kingdom'.
